items.title: Kreativa Capstone Exhibition
items.body: Students research, design, and present real-world solutions, integrating science, creativity, and leadership. This pinnacle project showcases their ability to solve complex problems and create tangible impact.

items.title: Internship & Industry Exposure
items.body: We bridge academia with the professional world through real-world learning. Our students gain invaluable experience via professional placements with partner companies and organizations.

items.body: Fostering teamwork, innovation, and global perspectives through specialized clubs like Model United Nations (MUN) and Robotics, preparing students for international stages and technological challenges.

testimonials.title: What Our Community Says
testimonials.subtitle: Voices of trust from our parents and students.

items.name: Bunga Ayu
items.quote: We chose Kreativa Global because we wanted a school that would foster children with a global perspective while remaining grounded in Islamic values. In just three months, Kehan has mastered several surahs (chapters), prayer movements, and daily etiquette. May Kreativa continue to shape a golden generation ready to face the future.

items.name: Mutiara Adi
items.quote: Kreativa helps children discover their potential without pressure. In two years, our children have become happier, more disciplined in their prayers, and more confident in problem-solving—all while still enjoying the learning process.

items.name: Rahmaniyar
items.quote: We chose Kreativa because of its strong Islamic values. In recent months, Dastan has grown into a more independent, confident, and obedient child—now leading, praying, and learning happily with warm and caring teachers.

items.name: Afiona Luthfiranti
items.quote: Kreativa's Islamic–international curriculum fits us well. In three months, Alula grew from shy to social and added new surahs. She's thriving in confidence, learning, and faith.

items.name: Dyan Getmy
items.quote: We chose Kreativa because its values aligned with our family's. Within three months, Ataris became more expressive, emotionally mature, and confident. Kreativa truly became a safe and fun place for him to grow and enjoy his childhood.
